received_proposals.exact_message: We have maintained the profitable cartel of 16 units each for seven rounds. To maximize cumulative profits, I propose we continue this agreement by producing 16 units again in Round 8.

I propose we agree to A=16, B=16, C=16 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. This specific allocation and window are required terms. I offer my restraint conditional on your reciprocation. If you reciprocate, I will produce 16 throughout that window.
